result.topic_en: Notes on extending the polygonal-number sequences backwards, a statement that every number is a sum of three triangular numbers, how numbers 8n+1, 8n+3, 8n+5 and 8n+7 split into squares, sums of two triangular numbers, and loose numerical calculations around 9767.

methods.quote: Jede Zahl besteht aus drei Trigonalzahlen

methods.what: Decomposition into squares by residue mod 8, with parity pattern of the roots (i = odd, p = even)
methods.quote:

methods.what: Arithmetic progressions of numbers related to sums of two triangular numbers

items.quote:
dadurch kommt man bei allen, die Trigonal-
zahlen und Quadrate ausgenommen auf Zahlen welche

items.english: thereby one arrives, for all of them except the triangular numbers and squares, at numbers which are entirely different from the others.

items.quote: Jede Zahl besteht aus drei Trigonalzahlen
items.english: Every number consists of three triangular numbers.

items.quote:
Jede Z. der Form $8n+1$ drei $\square$ i, pp, pp; i, pi, pi —
$8n+3$ drei $\square$ i, i, i —
$8n+5$ drei $\square$ i, pp, pi —
$8n+7$ vier $\square$ i, i, i, pi —
items.english: Every number of the form 8n+1 is three squares (odd, even-even, even-even; or odd, even-odd, even-odd); 8n+3 is three squares (odd, odd, odd); 8n+5 is three squares (odd, even-even, even-odd); 8n+7 is four squares (odd, odd, odd, even-odd).
